verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency and documented rate limits are a fair question for a tool-integration SaaS platform like Composio, so the axis applies. However, none of the evidence covers pricing per tool call or connection, plan tiers, or rate limits; the items are about sessions, MCP, authentication, triggers, and the CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
